blocks.name: inline-error
blocks.label: Inline notification
blocks.provenance: PROVENANCE: rendered-dom · react.carbondesignsystem.com, 2026-08-27 components-notifications-inline--default, --toast--default and --actionable--inline. All three variants diffed and matched. Three defects the diff found, none of which any name-based gate could see: TOAST put its icon inside __details. __details is display:block, so the icon stacked ABOVE the text instead of beside it and every toast was 38px too tall. React makes the icon a direct child of the root, which is a flex row. ACTIONABLE borrowed inline-notification__* for its wrappers. It has its own __focus-wrapper, __details, __text-wrapper and __content, all with real rules, and they were going unused. The action button carried --btn--sm without --layout--size-sm. --btn--sm sets border-radius and nothing else; the height comes from the layout class, so a "small" button was rendering at 48px. Same trap as --btn--lg in ui-shell.html: size is --layout--size-*, not --btn--<size>. The visually-hidden sentinels are copied because React renders them, but nothing here traps focus — they are markup fidelity, not behaviour, and Phase 5 is where they would start doing something.
